name: Perfect Pitch
summary:
Train your musical ear with the Perfect Pitch app! Match sounds to notes and chords to score points. Use the app to improve your music skills and impress your friends! 

Perfect Pitch lets you practice with individual piano notes or guitar chords. Level up your listening to improve your improvisation abilities!

Perfect Pitch is an ideal app for all types of musicians who want to improve their skills. Develop your chord recognition so you can jam in any situation!
